A note

Gifts

Having you in the room is the part we will remember. Travelling to Budapest, taking the day off, standing with us: that is already a generous gift, and nothing more is expected.

If you would still like to give something, we are saving towards our first home together, so a contribution towards that means more to us than anything we could unwrap. There will be a box at the reception, and we will be grateful either way.

How we got here

Our story

  1. 2021

    A queue at Keleti station

    Emeka was two weeks into Budapest and holding a ticket machine hostage. Réka translated, then stayed for coffee that turned into four hours. Neither of us caught the train we came for.

  2. 2023

    Lagos at Christmas

    Réka met the family, learned to fold moin moin badly, and was adopted on the spot. Emeka watched his mother hand over her jollof recipe, which is how we knew.

  3. 2026

    The question, on Gellért Hill

    A walk that was supposedly about the view. It was cold, the speech was too long, and the answer came before the end of it.

Once the formal part ends

After the ceremony and reception

The day runs long and easy. Here is what happens once each part ends.

After the ceremony

Drinks and photographs in the chapel garden until 16:00. Coaches then run to Villa Aurora, or the drive is twenty minutes if you have your own car.

After the reception

Dinner and speeches close around 22:00, and the dancing carries on in the Garden Hall until 02:00. The bar stays open, and taxis can be called from reception.

The next day

A slow brunch at the villa from 11:00 for anyone still in town. No dress code, no speeches, come as you are.
